description: D-Tools Cloud connects ChatGPT to your D-Tools Cloud account so you can ask read-only questions about pipeline, quotes, projects, clients, account health, procurement risk, and related business data. The app can confirm your connection, list accessible accounts, target an authorized account for Ask D-Tools questions, and retrieve grounded D-Tools Help Center guidance with canonical source links—without creating, updating, sending, or approving tenant records.
